fields.label: Project type
fields.question: What kind of project is it?
fields.why: Lenders judge a project by what you are doing with it and how far along it is.
fields.task: Confirm the project type

fields.label: Current stage
fields.question: How far along is the project?
fields.why: Investors fund a project differently depending on how far it has come.
fields.task: Confirm the current stage

fields.label: Asset type
fields.question: What type of product are you building?
fields.why: Sets which lenders and investors are relevant.
fields.task: Confirm asset type

fields.label: Location
fields.question: Which city, town or village is the project in?
fields.why: Local market depth decides who will lend.
fields.task: Name the town or village

fields.label: Units and area
fields.question: How many units, and what total saleable area?
fields.why: Cost and revenue per m² are checked against this.
fields.task: Confirm unit count and saleable area from the design

fields.label: Unit mix and target prices
fields.question: What is the unit mix and the target price per m²?
fields.why: Investors test your prices against local comparables.
fields.task: Price each unit type against 5–10 local comparables

fields.label: Land control
fields.question: Do you control the land today?
fields.why: Lenders fund land you own or can secure at closing.

chips.label: Purchase agreed (option / arras)
chips.task: Complete the purchase or extend the option

chips.label: Still negotiating
chips.task: Sign a binding option or purchase agreement

fields.task: Confirm land control with title or a signed option

fields.label: Land cost
fields.question: What did the land cost, or what will it cost?
fields.why: Land is usually the first number a lender compares with the valuation.
fields.task: Confirm land price from the deed or option

fields.label: Title and charges
fields.question: Do you have a recent nota simple, and is the land free of charges?
fields.why: A lender’s lawyer checks this first. A mortgage or lien changes who ranks first.

chips.label: Yes, clean
chips.note: A clean nota simple removes the first thing a lender’s lawyer checks.

chips.label: Yes, but there is a mortgage
chips.value: Nota simple shows an existing mortgage
chips.note: An existing mortgage is workable if it is repaid from the new facility. I added it to your plan.
chips.task: Agree how the mortgage is repaid or refinanced at closing

fields.task: Order a nota simple and review the charges
fields.doc: Nota simple (land registry extract) and cadastral reference

fields.label: Planning status
fields.question: What is the planning status of the plot?
fields.why: Decides whether a licence is realistic and how long it takes.

chips.label: Needs a planning change
chips.note: A planning change is a long item. Most lenders will wait for it before committing.
chips.task: Start the planning change with the town hall

fields.task: Request the planning certificate (certificado urbanístico)

fields.label: Project entity
fields.question: Which legal entity will own the project?
fields.why: Most lenders lend to a dedicated SPV with its own accounts.

chips.label: Existing company
chips.task: Set up a dedicated SPV for this project

fields.task: Set up the project SPV and share the cap table

fields.label: Track record
fields.question: How many projects have you delivered, and what size?
fields.why: First-time sponsors usually need a stronger team or more equity.

chips.label: 6 projects · €28M delivered
chips.note: A delivered track record is one of the strongest items in a lender’s file.

chips.label: This is my first project
chips.note: First projects are financeable, but lenders will ask for a stronger team or more equity.
chips.task: Add an experienced partner or contractor to the sponsor team

fields.task: Write a one-page track record: address, cost and result per project

fields.label: Core team
fields.question: Who is on the team: architect, project manager, contractor?
fields.why: Data room reviewers want names, roles and licences.

chips.label: Architect only
chips.task: Name the project manager and contractor

fields.task: List the team with roles and licences

fields.label: Total project cost
fields.question: What is the total project cost, all in: land, build, fees, taxes and finance?
fields.why: Every ratio a lender looks at starts here.
fields.task: Estimate the all-in cost

fields.label: Expected sales value (GDV)
fields.question: What do you expect to sell all units for, in total?
fields.why: Margin and loan-to-value are both measured against this.
fields.task: Estimate total sales value from comparables

fields.label: Cost budget by line
fields.question: Do you have a line-by-line cost budget with a contingency?
fields.why: Lenders review the budget and the contingency before anything else.

chips.label: Yes, no contingency
chips.note: No contingency is a common finding. It takes days to fix, so I added it as a quick task.
chips.task: Add a contingency of at least 5% and re-run the budget

chips.label: Only a total number
chips.task: Build a line-by-line budget

fields.task: Build a line-by-line budget with contingency

fields.label: Financial model and sensitivities
fields.question: Do you have a financial model with price and cost sensitivities?
fields.why: Shows how the deal behaves if prices or costs move.

chips.label: Basic spreadsheet only
chips.task: Add price and cost sensitivities to the model

fields.task: Build a financial model with price and cost sensitivities

fields.label: Design stage
fields.question: What stage is the design at?
fields.why: The basic project is the base for the licence and the budget.

chips.label: Sketch design only
chips.task: Complete the basic project (proyecto básico)

chips.label: Not started
chips.task: Commission and complete the basic project

fields.task: Complete the basic project (proyecto básico)

fields.label: Building licence
fields.question: What is the status of the building licence (licencia de obra)?
fields.why: Without a licence most senior lenders will not issue terms.

chips.label: Granted
chips.note: A granted licence is the single biggest de-risking item for a senior lender.

chips.label: Submitted, waiting
chips.value: Submitted, waiting for the town hall
chips.note: Waiting time depends on the town hall. I put it on the roadmap as 60 days. You can start preparing the lender pack in parallel.
chips.task: Track the licence and answer town hall requests

chips.label: Not submitted yet
chips.note: This is the longest item on most roadmaps, so I will put it first.
chips.task: Submit the licence application and track it

fields.task: Submit the licence application and track it

fields.label: Utilities, fees and other approvals
fields.question: Are utilities, taxes (ICIO) and other approvals confirmed?
fields.why: Data room reviewers check that nothing else can stop the build.

chips.label: Partly
chips.task: Confirm the remaining utilities and fees

fields.task: Confirm utilities, ICIO tax and the fees schedule

fields.label: Contractor
fields.question: Have you selected a contractor?
fields.why: Investors price the build risk by who builds.

chips.label: Tendering
chips.task: Finish the tender and select a contractor

chips.label: Not chosen yet
chips.task: Tender to 3 contractors and select one

fields.task: Tender the build to 3 contractors and select one

fields.label: Build programme
fields.question: How many months will the build take?
fields.why: Interest cost and exit timing depend on it.
fields.task: Agree a build programme with the contractor

fields.label: Build contract
fields.question: What kind of build contract do you have or plan?
fields.why: A fixed price moves cost overrun risk to the contractor.

chips.label: Cost plus
chips.task: Negotiate a fixed price or a guaranteed maximum price

chips.label: Not signed
chips.task: Sign a fixed-price build contract

fields.task: Sign a fixed-price build contract

fields.label: Insurance and supervision
fields.question: Are decennial insurance and technical supervision arranged?
fields.why: Required in Spain for new residential. Lenders ask for proof.

chips.label: Not yet
chips.task: Arrange decennial insurance and a technical supervisor

fields.task: Arrange decennial insurance and technical supervision

fields.label: Capital sought
fields.question: How much capital do you need?
fields.why: The starting point for every match.
fields.task: Confirm the amount needed

fields.label: Preferred instrument
fields.question: What kind of capital do you prefer?
fields.why: Debt and equity investors are different people.

chips.label: Not sure, advise me
chips.note: Good. I will compare options once cost, equity and exit are in.

fields.task: Choose the preferred instrument

fields.label: Your equity in the deal
fields.question: How much of your own capital goes in, including the land?
fields.why: Lenders want meaningful sponsor money at risk before theirs.
fields.task: Document your equity: land valuation and proof of cash
fields.doc: Proof of equity (land value + bank statement)

fields.label: Repayment and security
fields.question: How will the loan be repaid, and what security can you offer?
fields.why: Defines what the lender can fall back on.

chips.label: Unit sales + first mortgage on the land
chips.value: Unit sales proceeds + first mortgage on the land

chips.label: Not defined
chips.task: Define the repayment waterfall and security package

fields.task: Define the repayment waterfall and security package

fields.label: Exit strategy
fields.question: How will you exit: who buys, and when?
fields.why: Lenders are repaid from the exit, so they underwrite it first.

chips.label: Sell units off-plan and on completion
chips.value: Sell units off-plan and on completion

chips.label: Sell the whole building to one investor

fields.task: Decide the exit route and timing

fields.label: Pre-sales
fields.question: How many units are reserved or pre-sold?
fields.why: Pre-sales are the strongest proof that your prices are real.

chips.label: None yet
chips.task: Open reservations with a deposit agreement

chips.label: 3 of 12 reserved
chips.task: Convert reservations and open more

chips.label: 6 of 12 signed
chips.note: Half pre-sold is a strong signal to a lender.

fields.task: Open reservations with a deposit agreement

fields.label: Price evidence
fields.question: Do you have comparable sales to support your prices?
fields.why: Valuers and lenders will check prices against recent sales.

chips.label: A few listings
chips.task: Collect 5–10 recent comparable sales

fields.task: Collect 5–10 recent comparable sales

fields.label: Sales timeline
fields.question: What is the sales timeline after completion?
fields.why: Sets how long the loan stays outstanding.

chips.label: Sell out within 6 months
chips.value: Sell out within 6 months of completion

chips.label: 12 months
chips.value: Sell out within 12 months of completion

fields.task: Write the sales timeline
